title: Reload when the file changes
description:
Decide when to reload a plugin from file change times, without reloading half-written files.

```
t=0   fire.dll written (time 100)
t=1   fire.dll written again (time 101)  -> wait, still changing
t=3   no change for 2 s                    -> reload fire.dll (copy to fire.loaded.dll)
t=10  fire.pdb changed                     -> ignored
```
hints: When the time changes, store it with `since = now` and `reloaded = false`; when it stays the same for 2 seconds and was not reloaded, reload it (lesson 5.03).
Return the actions as text (`"copy fire.dll -> fire.loaded.dll"`, `"load fire.loaded.dll"`) so they are easy to test.
requirements: Feed `(now, file, modified time)` observations to a `Watcher`.
Reload only after the time has stayed the same for 2 seconds (a debounce).
Copy the DLL to a new name before loading, so the compiler can overwrite the original next time; ignore files that are not `.dll`.
stretch: Unload the old copy first and delete it after the new one loads.
